title: Special permit for tower design at 2950 West 24th Street, Brooklyn
summary: This special permit would let the developer distribute floor area across zoning district boundaries and modify building distance, height and setback rules for a proposed development at 2950 West 24th Street in Coney Island, Brooklyn. It is one of four related land use actions facilitating an 18-story, about 334,300-square-foot mixed-use building with 408 income-restricted units, ground-floor community facility and commercial space, and open space. The City Council's Land Use Committee recommended approval on July 14, 2026.
